title: CORE-7009 · "How we are rated" review stars render larger/heavier than live
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7009](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7009/rf-shared-how-we-are-rated-review-stars-render-largerheavier-than-live) · state `In Progress` · priority P4

## Ticket (verbatim from Linear)

**Scope:** SHARED — the *How we are rated* reviews widget (Trustpilot + Google star ratings). The widget is reused sitewide (e.g. homepage) — full list of pages confirmed so far under **Impacted pages** below; QA to extend as tested.
**Live:** [https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/faqs/](<https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/faqs/>) · **Test:** [https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app/faqs](<https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app/faqs>)
**Breakpoints:** all (star sizing is breakpoint-independent — seen at 360 and 1800).

## Impacted pages (24 confirmed)

`/faqs/`, `/faqs/directors/`, `/faqs/shares-and-shareholders/`, `/faqs/limited-by-guarantee/`, `/faqs/limited-liability-partnerships/`, `/faqs/company-records-and-registers/`, `/faqs/pscs/`, `/faqs/directors-service-address/`, `/faqs/vat/`, `/faqs/company-names/`, `/faqs/company-secretary/`, `/faqs/self-assessment/`, `/faqs/the-formation-process/`, `/business-telephone/`, `/company-dissolution/`, `/company-name-change/`, `/confirmation-statement-service/`, `/director-appointment-resignation/`, `/dormant-company-accounts/`, `/ico-registration/`, `/issue-of-shares/`, `/psc-filing/`, `/transfer-of-shares/`, `/vat-registration/`

**Issue** — The Trustpilot and Google rating **stars render larger / heavier** on the clone than on live, and sit more tightly packed, so the whole star row reads bigger and darker.

### What's wrong

* Each star's box measures **25×25 on both** sites and the fill colour matches (Trustpilot green `rgb(94,178,124)`), so it's not a box-size or colour difference.
* The difference is the **star icon itself**: clone uses SVG `viewBox="0 0 25 24"`, live uses `viewBox="0 0 51 48"`. The clone glyph fills more of its 25×25 box → the visible star is chunkier and the 5-star row is tighter, reading as larger and heavier (this is what looks like a "darker" rating row — the rating *text* below measures identical: weight 400, `rgb(89,89,89)`).
* Applies to **both** the Trustpilot and Google star groups.

### Where to locate in the clone repo

| Grep anchor | Element | Change |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Reviews / "How we are rated" star rating component | star `<svg>` (`viewBox 0 0 25 24`) | Match live's star icon size/proportion (live viewBox `0 0 51 48`) so stars render the same visual size/weight |

### Definition of Done

- [ ] Trustpilot + Google review stars render at live's visual size/weight (not larger/chunkier).
- [ ] Verified on `/faqs/`, `/faqs/directors/`, `/faqs/shares-and-shareholders/` (and any other page using the widget).
- [ ] Star fill colours + rating text unchanged (already match).
- [ ] No layout regression to the widget.

### Evidence

**Trustpilot stars zoomed (4×) — Live vs Clone** (clone stars bigger + tighter):

| Live | Clone |
| -- | -- |
|  |  |

**Full widget @1800 — Live vs Clone:**

| Live | Clone |
| -- | -- |
|  |  |

Confirmed the same way on every page listed under **Impacted pages**: live renders **10 star SVG nodes with 3 distinct glyph signatures** (full / partial / empty); the clone renders **20 SVG nodes with 1 signature**, and a 4× zoom of the Trustpilot row shows the clone's stars visibly wider with the gaps between them closed up. Star fill colour and the rating text below match on both.

---
### Routing note (Planning)
`rapid-formations-clone` has **no clone engine** — no `walk-dom-cdp.ts` / `emit-block.ts` /
`verify-clone.ts`, and zero `*Clone` blocks. Every block here is hand-authored, so the
engine-first rule has nothing to diagnose into: this is a **direct fix in the block that
has the defect**. That is why the task is tagged `bug` — it is NOT a fidelity loophole.

**Ship path:** Mode X — `clone-pull-request-create` with per-breakpoint PROD-vs-clone
screenshot proof, land `awaiting-user`, **the USER merges the PR**. Never merge to main.
Live source of truth: `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk` · clone:
`https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app`. ⛔ HEADED browser only for any visual check.
acceptanceCriteria: Trustpilot + Google review stars render at live's visual size/weight (not larger/chunkier) — clone star SVG matches live's glyph proportion (live viewBox `0 0 51 48`, clone currently `0 0 25 24`).
Verified on `/faqs/`, `/faqs/directors/`, `/faqs/shares-and-shareholders/` (and any other page using the widget).
Star fill colours + rating text unchanged (already match live: Trustpilot green `rgb(94,178,124)`, text weight 400 `rgb(89,89,89)`).
No layout regression to the widget at 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800.
